paper.title: Federated Linear Contextual Bandits with Heterogeneous Clients

settings.name_in_paper: Federated linear contextual bandits with heterogeneous (clustered) clients
unmapped: N clients each with own parameter theta_i; clients form M unknown clusters with within-cluster distance <= epsilon = 1/(N sqrt(T)) and between-cluster separation >= gamma
Each round each client receives K arms drawn i.i.d. from a sub-Gaussian distribution with E[x x^T] having minimum eigenvalue lambda_c > 0 (context regularity)
Star-shaped communication: server can broadcast only one model per time step; communication cost also measured
Regret summed over all N clients
The learner's exploration length T_0 uses gamma, lambda_c and psi^d (which depends on M); the learner knows gamma and lambda_c
settings.definition_quote: In each time step $t=1,2,...T$, each client $i \in {N}$ chooses an action $x_{t,i}$ from its action set $\mathcal{A}_{t,i} = \{{x}_{t,1}, {x}_{t,2}...,x_{t,K}\}$, where $x\in \bR^d$. ... the corresponding reward received by client $i$ is $y_{t,i} = \langle \theta_i^{*},{x}_{t,i}\rangle + \eta_t$, where noise $\eta_t$ comes from a $\sigma^2$ sub-Gaussian distribution ... $\|x\|_2 \leq 1$ and $\|\theta_{i}^*\| \leq 1$.

symbols.sum_clusters: sum over the M clusters k=1..M
symbols.psi_d: psi^d = F^{-1}(delta/(N^2(M-1)); d, upsilon^c), inverse noncentral chi^2 CDF
symbols.lambda_c: minimum eigenvalue of E[x x^T] (context regularity)

conditions: Assumption 1: clients in same cluster within epsilon = 1/(N sqrt(T))
Assumption 2: clients in different clusters separated by gamma
Assumption 3: contexts i.i.d. sub-Gaussian with lambda_min(E[x x^T]) >= lambda_c > 0

source.label: thm:regret_comm
source.quote: With an exploration phase length of $T_0 = \frac{16\psi^d \sigma^2}{\lambda_c \gamma^2}$, with probability $1-\delta$ our protocol achieves a cumulative regret of R_T = O( \frac{N\psi^d \sigma^2}{\lambda_c \gamma^2} + \sum_{k=1}^M d\sqrt{|C_k|T}\log^{2}(|C_k|T) + d|C_k|^2M\log(|C_k|\,T)), where $\psi^{d}=F^{-1}\big(\frac{\delta}{N^{2}(M-1)};d,\upsilon^{c}\big)$, with communication cost ...

results.notes: Regret defined via means summed over N clients against per-round best arm (pseudo-regret form) but stated w.p. 1-delta. Paper discusses special cases informally: M=1 gives O~(d sqrt(NT)), M=N gives O~(dN sqrt(T)), equal clusters give O~(d sqrt(MNT)).

source.label: thm:regret_comm
source.quote: with communication cost C_{T}= O(Nd^2) + \sum_{k=1}^M O(|C_k|^{1.5} \cdot d^3).

results.notes: Communication cost (number of scalars communicated), not regret. Probability qualifier taken from theorem context.
